_OBJECTIVE: Verify that S-band PSR (2.8 GHz frequency tag) shows minimal Pd reduction in moderate rain. Compare detection count and quality against TC-02 baseline.
_PASS_CRITERIA: Pd drop < 5% at 100km vs TC-02 baseline. Quality > 80%. Track continuity > 90%.
_NOTE: S-band has low ITU-R P.838-3 attenuation. The frequency tag is metadata consumed by applyRainDegradation.m, not a fusionRadarSensor property.
description: TC-03: S-band PSR (2.8 GHz) in moderate rain (16 mm/hr) — expect minimal degradation
